description: Inputs passed to the Xerberus common-cause policy WASM at evaluation time

wallets.description: Wallet addresses (0x-prefixed) holding the positions to compare. At least two Xerberus register-mapped venues across them are needed for a meaningful result.

chain.description: Optional Xerberus chain identifier. Only ethereum is supported today; defaults to ethereum.

window.description: Optional Xerberus data-window timestamp (ISO-8601). Pass the same value to every xerberus_* pack in a composite.
